metadata.title: Mass modelling of dwarf spheroidal galaxies: the effect of unbound stars from tidal tails and the Milky Way

notes: No eligible stars. The paper’s “unbound” stars are unbound from the dwarf galaxy, not from the Milky Way: T:p4-b3 defines the bound/unbound classification by treating the dwarf as an isolated object, while T:p3-b6 places the simulated dwarf on an orbit bound to the Milky Way. The Fornax analysis concerns member and interloper stars in a Milky Way satellite, not stars identified as Galactic unbound candidates.
